verdicts.title: Coxeter orbits and Brauer trees
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the cohomology with modular coefficients of Deligne-Lusztig varieties associated to Coxeter elements. verdicts.title: Graded Brauer Tree Algebras
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper we construct non-negative gradings on a basic Brauer tree algebra $A_Γ$ corresponding to an arbitrary Brauer tree $Γ$ of type $(m,e)$. We do this by transferring gradings via derived equivalence from a basic Brauer tree algebra $A_S$, whose tree is a star with the exceptional vertex in the middle, to $A_Γ$. verdicts.title: The central tree property and algorithmic problems on subgroups of free groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the average case complexity of the uniform membership problem for subgroups of free groups, and we show that it is orders of magnitude smaller than the worst case complexity of the best known algorithms.
